overview_description.description: Sublime Security is the adaptive, AI-powered cloud email security platform that combines effectiveness with visibility and control. The open platform allows security teams to have transparency and flexibility in their email environment to spend less time on email-originated incidents. Advanced teams can customize detections, threat hunt, extend Sublime into their SIEM or SOAR, and collaborate with other teams.

about_short_description.short_description: Sublime Security develops an email security platform to write and run custom detection and response rules to block phishing attacks.

product.name: Sublime Email Security Platform
product.description: An adaptive email security platform that detects, blocks, investigates, and remediates phishing, business email compromise, malware, ransomware, and other email threats.

product.name: EML Analyzer
product.description: A web-based and API-accessible tool for analyzing individual email files, examining suspicious links, and generating insights into potential phishing and other email threats.

product.name: Sublime Core Feed
product.description: A live threat intelligence feed containing email threat data from the Sublime platform for use in security monitoring, investigation, and defensive workflows.

product.name: Sublime API and Integrations
product.description: API-driven connectivity for email providers, SIEMs, SOAR platforms, storage systems, and other security tools to automate detection, investigation, response, and data export.
